description: This file is a CLI script for the 'universalinit' project. It handles command-line arguments to initialize various project templates, parse parameters, generate project configuration objects, retrieve template initialization info, and output structured JSON responses. It also supports a special mode to fetch the run command for a specific project type.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with intelligent type conversions (bool, int, float).

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments, parsing parameters string.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance for retrieving template info, with default values and optional parameters parsing.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a given relative path into an absolute path based on a base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Transforms a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, converting file paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a structured JSON response indicating success or failure, including optional template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs a JSON object containing the project type and its associated run command.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the --get-run-command logic: creates a minimal config, retrieves the template, and outputs the run command, with error handling.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point parsing command line arguments, executing project initialization or retrieving the run command, with comprehensive workflow and error handling.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
